claims.text: Machine learning-based computational models can be used to design intrinsically strong, ductile, and low-weight refractory high-entropy alloy compositions.
Machine learning models can predict alloy properties relevant to refractory high-entropy alloy design.
Optimization of predicted alloy properties by machine learning can identify desirable refractory high-entropy alloy compositions.
High-entropy alloys consist of multiple principal elements and therefore have a very large composition space.
Thermo-kinetic analysis and simulations are existing approaches for high-entropy alloy composition design.
The proposed method is limited to high-entropy alloys and refractory high-entropy alloys.
The effectiveness of machine learning models for predicting and optimizing refractory high-entropy alloy properties is uncertain.
The hypothesis would be falsified if machine learning models fail to improve prediction accuracy and composition-optimization efficiency relative to thermo-kinetic analysis and simulations.
